hyp.code_patch:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    fcols = train.feats(df)
    y = df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    X = df[fcols].to_numpy()
    idx = np.arange(len(df))
    tr, te = train_test_split(idx, test_size=0.25, random_state=seed)
    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X[tr])
    Xtr_s = scaler.transform(X[tr])
    Xte_s = scaler.transform(X[te])
    sel = SelectKBest(f_classif, k=train.K).fit(Xtr_s, y[tr])
    Xtr_k = sel.transform(Xtr_s)
    Xte_k = sel.transform(Xte_s)
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(Xtr_k, y[tr], Xte_k, seed)
    y_true = y[te]
    return (y_true, y_pred)
